# RN-7 (KOBE-751): team namespace prefix as configuration (spec §5). Mostly hand work: the chart
# sets sandbox.teamNamespacePrefix from a lookup (default `kaiju-team-` on a fresh install), the
# server refuses to start when namespaces with another prefix exist. The script renames the
# literal defaults and examples below once that configuration exists.
#
# Same format as allowlist.txt (scripts/rename/README.md). The script changes an occurrence only
# where a pattern below matches it AND the allowlist gives it to this step AND no permanent entry
# covers it. Generated files and the allowlist's "Triage:" groups are left out on purpose: the
# dry run lists them as left for hand edits until this step's ticket narrows them into patterns.

== RN-7: Team namespace prefix (configuration: new default `kaiju-team-`, detected on existing installs)
** /\bkobe-team-(?!quota\b|member-quota\b)/
** /\bkobe-team\b(?!-)/
